caption: YOLO11m, signer-independent protocol, test predictions of 1 fold (test signer s1) × 2 training seeds combined (preliminary) (1052 image–seed pairs). A frame is assigned to the class of its highest-scoring detection with IoU ≥ 0.5 to the ground-truth box, keeping only detections at or above each run's confidence threshold conf_thr (chosen on validation); 'missed' = no such detection. Rows are normalised to the number of ground-truth frames of the class (in brackets); the background row gives counts of detections with IoU < 0.5. 14 further (duplicate) detections overlapping the ground truth are not counted.
